items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: Buddy Bowling come up. And Buddy Bowling learned how to play college on the manual hall. And he got to be famous himself.

ctx.x: Peyton, he used to be an accordion player. And then Buddy Bowling come up. And Buddy Bowling learned how to play college on the manual hall. And he got to be famous himself.
Oh, I see. Was Peyton before Bolden? Did Peyton have a band before Bolden? Oh, yeah. He was an older man?
